inspiration: Grunt-type trooper: a short look loop, a quick flinch, a death chain, and a separate heavy-death chain for big hits (info.c states near lines 310-330). Recreate the timing pattern with our own timings and silhouette.

Effects as objects with tiny state chains: a dust puff for wall hits and a blood object for flesh hits (info.c lines 226-229). Recreate the idea with sparks on armour and ember puffs, not the same sprites.
The player has a separate extreme-death chain (info.c line 301). The death presentation picks a branch by hit size, so a heavy kill reads differently.
Weapons as four-state chains: ready, lower, raise, fire (info.c lines 135-140 show the chain shape). One sprite family per weapon keeps them readable at phone width.
Sound cues with a priority number so the loud cue wins when many play at once (sounds.c line 119 shape). Keep the priority idea; change the names and timbres.
One family prefix per object family keeps the asset vocabulary small (info.c line 41).
Object table as one row per type linking spawn and see states, with death-related states such as xdeathstate (info.c lines 1106 and 1122). A data-first way to build creatures from states.

briefs.label: Grunt heavy-death chain (creature)
briefs.why: A readable collapse: a normal death for small hits and a separate heavy branch for big hits, so the player sees damage size.
briefs.keep: short two-frame idle loop; quick flinch; death chain; separate heavy-death chain
briefs.change: armoured silhouette instead of a uniform trooper; a glowing seam that flares in the heavy death; our own timings and collapse direction
briefs.ref: linuxdoom-1.10/info.c lines 310-330 (state chain; sprite art not in box, not read)

briefs.label: Dust puff and blood splat (effects)
briefs.why: Two effect objects make the surface readable: dust for walls, blood for flesh; both pop at spawn and fade fast.
briefs.keep: one effect per surface type; full-bright at spawn; short chain
briefs.change: sparks on armour and ember puffs instead of blood on metal; a different palette; no blood on the Pit floor

briefs.label: Four-state weapon chain (gear)
briefs.why: A weapon that reads as ready, lowers, raises and fires with four frames keeps the action clear at 375 wide.
briefs.keep: ready, lower, raise, fire as separate states; one family prefix per weapon
briefs.change: our own gear silhouette; a charge glow in place of the flash frame; our own sound cue

briefs.label: Priority sound cue table (sound)
briefs.why: Each cue carries a priority so the important one wins under load; this keeps the mix readable in a crowded fight.
briefs.keep: name plus priority per cue; link-style conflict handling if the design needs it
briefs.change: our own cue names and timbres; our own priority scale
